ev_0005.summary: Full circle (circle_01) centered at O (263.57,238.05), radius 196.71 px, 360 deg visible. Diameter AB is horizontal with A (66.81,237.98) and B (460.28,238.0); O is its midpoint. Chord DG is vertical at x=169 with D (169.0,65.56) and G (169.0,410.54), both on the circle. F (169.0,238.0) is the intersection of AB and DG. E (168.97,190.46) lies on DG, interior to the circle, and on line AC. Line AC runs from A to C (390.19,87.51), with C on the circle; the check against the AC line gives y≈190.44 at x=168.97, which confirms E on AC. A right angle is verified at F (CV mark at vertex (169,238), 15 px sides), so EF is perpendicular to AB. Segments AB and DG were snapped to labelled vertices (overshoots of 3-6 px are detector noise). OE and EF are supervisor-provided and not detected by CV as standalone segments; EF lies on DG.

payload.notes: Used STYLE METRICS scale s=0.017621 cm/px (longest side 8 cm) instead of the 1/100 suggestion, since the metrics block is present. Origin at O, y flipped. Circle drawn thin (0.6pt), other strokes 1.0pt with round joins; labels 14.5pt/17.4pt. Right-angle square 15 px = 0.264 cm at F with arms toward B and E. Dot at O. Segments drawn between GES endpoints; no overshoots present.
